description: Spin My Day. Build a day out. Leave out city and location to spin for a random city. Spin up a full day out (morning, lunch, afternoon, dinner, evening) around the weather and what is open, in a city, near a location, or in a random city.

budget.description: Budget: any, or free for free things only.

city.description: The city to plan the day in, for example Manchester or Austin, TX. Leave out with lat and lon for a random city.

date.description: The day to plan, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for today, or tomorrow when it is already past 5pm there (the answer then says tomorrow: true).

diet.description: Food needs, comma separated: halal, kosher, vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, gluten_free, dairy_free, jain. Lunch and dinner then name real places that OpenStreetMap lists for all of them (each meal says which in diet and diet_note). halal=true still works.

lat.description: Latitude, in decimal degrees, instead of city.

lon.description: Longitude, in decimal degrees, instead of city.

seed.description: Repeat a spin exactly; each answer includes a spin_again link with a new seed.

vibe.description: The feel of the day: chill, adventure, date, family, culture or foodie.

name: spinmyday_spin_my_day
title: Spin My Day: Build a day out
